profile.name: Manav Shah
profile.tagline: Building intelligent software, automation systems, and products that solve real-world problems.
profile.shortBio: AI Engineer with deep hands-on expertise in LLMs, generative AI pipelines, and applied machine learning. Dedicated to building high-reliability automation systems and end-to-end AI products.
aboutStory: I started my journey with a deep curiosity about how intelligent systems can automate tedious cognitive workflows and turn raw multi-modal data into structured, actionable insights.

Over the course of my B.Tech in Computer Engineering (Indus University, 9.70 CGPA) and M.Tech in Artificial Intelligence (Pandit Deendayal Energy University, 9.06 CGPA), I focused heavily on deep learning, EEG signal processing, neural network optimization, and computer vision.

At Analytix Solutions, I spearheaded TaxProGenie, automating 28+ U.S. tax forms for over 1.5 Lakh taxpayers with 98% accuracy using LLM classification, Azure Document Intelligence, and OpenAI/Claude extraction. I also architected AI-VOX and Artifax — systems transforming enterprise speech training and automated meeting documentation into real-world software.
Today, I combine rigorous research methodology with production-grade engineering to ship reliable, high-impact AI software that feels effortless to use.

projects.title: TaxProGenie
projects.shortDescription: AI-powered enterprise tax workflow automation processing 28+ U.S. tax forms across 150K+ taxpayers with 98% accuracy.
projects.fullDescription: TaxProGenie is an intelligent tax form classification, extraction, and validation pipeline. It automates high-volume U.S. tax return preparation by combining Azure Document Intelligence, custom LLM classification, schema-enforced OpenAI/Claude extraction, and automated Excel reconciliations.
projects.problem: Tax season manual entry required ~20 tax professionals spending 5–10 minutes per form manually inspecting scans, typing data, and cross-checking IRS rules across hundreds of thousands of taxpayer documents.
projects.solution: Engineered an end-to-end multi-stage pipeline: OCR/layout extraction -> multi-modal document classification -> zero-shot field extraction with JSON validation -> cross-field mathematical integrity checks -> direct generation of populated client workbooks.
architectureSteps: Document Ingestion & Multi-page PDF Splitting
Azure Document Intelligence Layout & Text Parsing
LLM-based Form Classification (28+ IRS Tax Form Types)
Prompt-Engineered Structured Key-Value Extraction (Claude / OpenAI)
Deterministic Validation, Reconciliation & Error Flagging
Automated Excel Ledger Generation for Tax Professionals
features: Batch PDF processing with zero-intervention queue management
High-precision extraction with 98% standard / 90% non-standard document accuracy
Discrepancy detection flagging inconsistent calculations before filing
Multi-tenant workspace supporting high concurrency during tax season
challenges: Handling low-resolution scans, handwritten annotations, and rotated pages
Strict zero-hallucination tolerance for numeric financial data and SSN/EIN fields
Optimizing API token costs and inference latency during peak batch jobs

engineeringDecisions.rationale: Using Azure Doc Intelligence for raw bounding boxes combined with LLMs for semantic reconciliation provided the best accuracy-cost balance.
Guaranteed deterministic structure and eliminated schema drift before Excel injection.

results: Reduced turnaround time from 5–10 min/form down to 1–2 min/PDF
Automated the core tax season workload of a 20-person operations team
lessonsLearned: Deterministic validation layers are essential when deploying generative AI in compliance-critical domains.
Batch queue chunking significantly mitigates rate-limit exhaustion.

projects.title: Artifax — Meeting-to-Documentation Pipeline
projects.shortDescription: Autonomous pipeline converting video meetings and demos into timestamped Word BRD documentation with flowcharts and key screenshots.
projects.fullDescription: Artifax ingests screen-share demo videos and team calls, extracts audio transcripts and visual frame changes, reconstructs step-by-step user workflows, and outputs structured Business Requirement Documents (BRD) complete with contextual screenshots and Mermaid flow diagrams.
projects.problem: Engineering teams spent hours manually replaying client handover recordings to write business documentation and architecture diagrams.
projects.solution: Built an automated pipeline utilizing keyframe difference analysis, audio-visual alignment, and LLM synthesis to produce publication-ready documentation in minutes.
architectureSteps: Video Ingestion & OpenCV Frame Difference Detection
Whisper Audio Transcription with Timestamp Alignment
Visual Keyframe Extraction & UI Bounding Box Highlighting
LLM Workflow Synthesis & Step Reconstruction
Mermaid Flowchart Generation
Formatted Word (.docx) Document Compilation
features: Automatic action detection linking transcript lines to matching video frames
Flow-diagram generation detailing user decision trees and UI navigation
One-click export to enterprise-formatted Word documents
challenges: Preventing redundant screenshots during static slide transitions
Maintaining precise sync between speech and UI actions

engineeringDecisions.decision: Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) for Keyframe Deduplication
engineeringDecisions.rationale: Drastically reduced image redundancy before prompting the vision model.

results: Cut documentation authoring time from 3–4 hours per meeting down to < 10 minutes
Directly accelerated client handoffs and internal engineering alignment
lessonsLearned: Combining visual frame shifts with NLP timestamps provides rich grounding that eliminates hallucinated steps.

notes.title: Building Deterministic AI Pipelines for Regulated Financial Workflows
notes.excerpt: How we achieved 98% accuracy processing 150,000+ U.S. tax returns without hallucination risks using schema enforcement and OCR bounding boxes.
notes.content:
# Building Deterministic AI Pipelines for Regulated Financial Workflows

When deploying Generative AI into compliance-heavy spaces like tax return preparation, the standard advice of "just write a better prompt" fails quickly. Here are the architectural principles we used to build TaxProGenie.

## 1. Grounding in Bounding Box Layouts
Never ask an LLM to "read" an entire multi-page scan blindly. We use Azure Document Intelligence to convert visual pixels into structured tokens with coordinate bounding boxes first.

## 2. Pydantic-First Schema Enforcement
Every extraction query targets an explicit Pydantic model. If a field fails type validation, mathematical integrity checks, or IRS formatting rules, it is immediately flagged for automated retry or human review before touching any spreadsheet.

## 3. Mathematical Reconciliation Layers
LLMs are notoriously weak at cross-row summing across complex multi-tier tables. We delegate all arithmetic to deterministic Python modules.

## Conclusion
Production AI is 20% prompt engineering and 80% defensive software architecture.

notes.title: Deep Feature Fusion for Cross-Subject EEG Sleep Stage Classification
notes.excerpt: Key takeaways from our IEEE publication combining EEGNet and BiLSTM networks with gated fusion mechanisms.
notes.content:
# Deep Feature Fusion for Cross-Subject EEG Sleep Stage Classification

Biomedical signal processing requires capturing both fine-grained temporal dynamics and high-level morphological wave patterns.

## The Architecture
Our model fuses:
- **Spatial Filters**: Lightweight depthwise separable convolutions to capture electrode channel correlations.
- **BiLSTM Temporal Memory**: Bidirectional LSTM layers to preserve long-range sleep cycle transitions.
- **Gated Fusion Unit**: Dynamically weights spatial vs. sequential feature representations.

Achieving 88.02% cross-subject accuracy proved that gated fusion mitigates individual subject variance effectively.
